_readme: KHAYAL product catalog, imported from Admin > Manage Products > Import KHAYAL catalog. New products are created as drafts (finish price, stock and photos in the admin, then set status to Active) unless price, stock and images are filled here. Existing products get the new copy and SEO fields but keep their price, stock, images and status. Scent notes for new products are suggestions: confirm them against the finished oils.

products.title: SILK ROYALE
products.description: SILK ROYALE opens with saffron and soft magnolia, settles into tuberose and a thread of oud, and finishes warm with vanilla and musk. It was made for evenings you want remembered: a mehndi, a valima, a dinner that runs late.
products.descriptionHtml:
SILK ROYALE opens with saffron and soft magnolia, settles into tuberose and a thread of oud, and finishes warm with vanilla and musk. It was made for evenings you want remembered: a mehndi, a valima, a dinner that runs late.

Spray on the neck and wrists and let it settle for a few minutes. Each bottle is hand-finished and comes in the KHAYAL presentation box, ready to gift.
